text:
Ava (People Ops): Heads-up — we're kicking off a focused 48-hour evidence sprint for SOC2 / ISO artifacts starting tomorrow 9:00 AM PT. Role owners, please upload required docs to Confluence and tag them with `soc2:evidence` and `iso:attestation`. If you're blocked, call it out here ASAP. :rocket:

Jon (Security): Quick Q — do we need raw logs or redacted extracts?

Ava (People Ops): Redacted extracts are fine as long as they show the retention policy and an example log snippet. If you need help redacting, ping @Jon or @DataTeam.

Maya (Eng): I can handle the eng-runtime incident playbook updates and upload today. Expect a PDF + checklist.

Luis (Product): Is there a single checklist we should follow?

Ava (People Ops): Yep — use the sprint checklist: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/SOC2-Sprint-Checklist (internal). Filename convention: `sprint-1786264820_<owner>_<artifact>.pdf`. Follow the doc tagging guide in the checklist.

Raj (Infra): Who owns the Dedicated infra network diagram?

Maya (Eng): I thought Raj volunteered last week?

Raj (Infra): Yup that's me — uploading network diagram + HSM/KMS config summary by 11am tomorrow.

Luis (Product): FYI some product docs reference customer PII flows — do we need a separate redaction step for those?

Jon (Security): For PII flows, include a data map + redaction notes. We just need enough detail to verify controls, not PII itself.

Ava (People Ops): Progress ask: try to get at least a stub (even a single page) in by EOD today so we can triage gaps first thing tomorrow. If you absolutely can't make it, request an extension here before EOD and include why + new ETA. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Maya (Eng): Stubbing playbook now, will upload a placeholder doc with TOC. :thumbsup:

evidence-bot: Scheduled reminder will post 1 hour before sprint start. Current snapshot: 8/23 artifacts uploaded, 5 owners unassigned. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/evidence/progress (internal link).

Ava (People Ops): Huge thanks — this sprint is critical for the audit timeline. I'll follow up with a short triage meeting invite 9:15 AM PT tomorrow for any blockers.
